findings.title: Invoke caveats describe obsolete sandbox behavior
findings.description: Lines 120-125 state that function Date.now() is not overridden and that functions declaring secrets fail closed in the sandbox. The current owner implementation does the opposite: the policy-test compiler strips declared secret grants so the function can execute with secret lookups returning null, while the dispatcher forwards policyTestTime as nowOverrideMs and the runtime shim overrides Date.now() and zero-argument new Date(). Authors following these caveats may skip testable secret-declaring functions or design clock tests around behavior the sandbox no longer has.
findings.recommendation: Document the current behavior: the logical clock is applied inside invoked functions, declared secret grants are stripped, and secret-dependent branches need explicit mocks or null handling.
